SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Oh—so this is what you meant, right?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あっ、これのことですか？
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ah, tá falando disso?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اوه-پس منظورت این بود، درسته؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: The one that’s super tasty…
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ここで一番おいしいけど
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: O rolinho de ovo.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: همونی که فوق العاده خوشمزه…

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: but also the tiniest portion here—the rolled omelet.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 但份量卻最少的這個玉子燒
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 量が一番少ない、この卵焼き
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: O mais gostoso, mas vem bem pouquinho.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Lo más rico pero que viene poquito
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اما همچنین کوچکترین قسمت در اینجا - املت رول شده.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Sigh. If you really want it… I guess I’ll share.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 唉，既然你想吃的话...当然得给你啦，嗯...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 啊，如果你想吃的話...就給你吧。嗯...
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: は…食べたいなら…どうぞ はい…
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Se quiser comer… vou ter que te dar o meu…
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Si quiere comerlo… tendré que dárselo…
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: آه اگر واقعاً اونو می خواهید ... فکر می کنم به اشتراک خواهم گذاشت.

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 어! 두 분 다 여기 계셨네요?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Oh! There you two are.
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あっ！お二人ここにいらしたんですね？
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ah! Aí estão vocês dois!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اوه! شما دو نفر هستید

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Oh? Wuseon, hey!
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: お？ウソンさん来たの？
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Hã? É o Wooseon.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اوه؟ ووسون، هی!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Hi there.
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: こんにちは
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Bom apetite.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: سلام.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Ah, yeah.
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あ、はい
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ah, obrigado.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: آه، آره

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Oh? We’ve got rolled omelet today?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あ、今日卵焼きあるんですね？
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Oh? Hoje tem rolinhos de ovo?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اوه؟ امروز املت رول شده داریم؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Why? What about it?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 卵焼きがどうかした？
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Por quê?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: چرا؟ در مورد اون چطور؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Isn’t that the one Chief really likes?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 这不是科长最爱吃的嘛
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 這不是課長最愛吃的嗎？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: これ、課長が好きなやつじゃないですか
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: É que a chefe Gran adora.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Es que a la jefa Gran le encantan.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: این چیزی نیست که رئیس واقعاً دوست دارد؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: It’s not exactly easy to give that one up.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 刚才看你好像舍不得给来着
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 剛才看好像很捨不得給的樣子
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あげるの戸惑ったみたいだし
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Parece que ela não quer dividir.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: کنار گذاشتن اون دقیقاً آسان نیست.

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 이거 그냥 쓰읍, 유만 씨 드세요.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Here, just... sigh, you take it, Yuman.
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: これ、そのまま…ユマンさん、食べてください
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Então… Yumán, come você.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اینجا، فقط... آه، تو اونو بگیر، یومان.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Whoa~ Wuseon, what’s with you?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 什么呀~优先你怎么这样
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 什麼啊～宇善你怎麼這樣說
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: なんですか〜ウソンさん、どうしたんですか？
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ai, por que você é assim, Wooseon?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اووووسون، چه خبر؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I was gonna give you mine.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 我是想把我这份给科长啦
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 我是想把我的這份給課長啦
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 僕のをあげようと思って
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Eu ia dar o meu pra ela.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Yo le iba a dar el mío
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: قرار بود مال خودمو بهت بدم

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Gasp! Wuseon...
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: えっ！ウソンさん…
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Wooseon, sério…!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: نفس نفس زدن ووسون...

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 우 사원 거 뺏지 마시고, 그냥 제 거 드세요!
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Don’t steal Wuseon’s portion—just take mine instead!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 别抢他的份啦，直接吃我的就好！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 不要搶他的那份，我的直接給你就好！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ウ社員のを取らないで、僕のをどうぞ！
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Não tira o dela, pega o meu.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: No le quites el suyo a Wooseon y tome el mío.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: سهم ووسون را ندزدید - فقط بخش من را بگیرید!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Seriously, Wuseons got the best timing.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 果然還是宇善最貼心了！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ほんとウソンさんは気が利くね！
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Nossa, Wooseon, você é tão atencioso!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: به طور جدی، ووسون بهترین زمان بندی را داشت.

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 제가 과장님 건 꽉 잡고 있잖아요~
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I’m holding tight to the Chief’s piece anyway~
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 科长的喜好我可都牢牢记在心里呢~
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 課長的喜好我可是都牢牢記在心裡呢！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 僕、課長のはしっかり持ってますからね〜！
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Chefe, ainda tô segurando o seu.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Jefa, todavía estoy sosteniendo el suyo.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: به هر حال من تیکه رئیس را محکم می گیرم~

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Thanks, Wuseon~
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ありがと〜ウソンさん
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Obrigada, Wooseon.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: ممنون، ووسون~
